summary: Fall Ball 2026 wrap-up: final scoreboard with team growth since 2024, sponsor thank-you, how Fall Ball works, the 2026 timeline and divisions, the last posted age guidelines (Baseball/Softball switch on phones) and the 2025 District 10 rule PDFs.
needs: VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen) and VP of Softball (Luke Kress): confirm next fall runs the same way (weekday practices starting in August, Saturday games, games against nearby leagues) and whether Juniors will be offered (it was not in Fall 2026).
VP of Baseball and VP of Softball: the age cutoffs and registration dates for Fall 2027 (spring 2028 league age), to replace the Fall 2025 age chart on this page.

VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen): Minors age conflict. This page keeps 'AAA (Minors player pitch) 10 to 11' from the 2025 guidelines, while the FAQ and Registration pages say Minors 9 to 11. One answer is needed for all three pages.
VP of Softball (Luke Kress): OK to show the Fall 2025 softball cutoff as 'Age on Dec 31, 2025' (the live page says 'as of January 1, 2026', the same rule)?
VP of Baseball and VP of Softball: the Fall 2027 District 10 rule PDFs when the district releases them. The 2025 PDFs stay up, labeled 2025.
Scheduler (Daniel Grande): confirm the 2026 numbers on the scoreboard and team bars (36 teams, 194 games, 91 against other D10 leagues). They come from the schedule, not social media.

President (Ramey Harguess) or Treasurer (Dan Swagman): confirm Spring 2027 registration opens Friday Nov 27 with $50 off per family, and when the discount ends. Social media has not announced it, and the Oct 25 and Nov 1 board minutes are not posted yet (Secretary Tawnie LaValley).

Sponsorship and Fundraising (Ashley Gauthier), optional: logos for the three Fall Ball 2026 sponsors (Molen Orthodontics, Great Northwest Dental, Northwest Cascade). The page thanks them by name until then.

sources.fact: Fall Ball 2026 sponsors: Molen Orthodontics, Great Northwest Dental, Northwest Cascade.
Fall Ball supported 32 teams in 2025, up from 5 in 2024 (team bars).
Fall Ball 2026 registration opened Jul 10 and ran through Aug 9; limited fields meant some divisions could fill early and go to a waitlist.
Fall Ball 2025 registration was open by Jul 17, 2025.

Fall Ball 2026: practices began mid-August; Saturday games Sep 12 to Oct 31; developmental season, register for the division expected in the spring; 8 divisions (Tee Ball co-ed; Baseball Coach Pitch, AA, Minors, Majors; Softball Minors B, Minors A, Majors); spring volunteers' background checks and Abuse Awareness courses stay valid.
Fall Ball is a great entry point to try coaching; coaches sign up through the player's registration.
Fall Ball 2026 is over; coaches return gear to the Daffodil Shed, Sat Nov 7, 10AM to 1PM.
